statement: A rollback is held to every break-glass rule: one that would create, alter or bring back a break-glass binding, or change the policy a live one grants, needs cosec:breakglass and a REQUIRED audit and never checks clean; one that only removes break-glass bindings needs neither and has no shadow window.
